_: The apps the SideStore source lists (ci/sidestore_source.py): each from this repository's releases tagged <tag>-<n> that carry an .ipa asset. Terra's own (since Nov 4, 2026, painting-company row 217) comes from toys.yml as terra-build-<n>; adrift.yml and toys.yml each regenerate the source from here (an app with no release yet is left out).

apps.name: Terra Incognita
apps.subtitle: The world, and the toys on it
apps.localizedDescription: The whole Earth as satellites saw it this month, and on it a living light for each of the toys: whales off California, starlings in Somerset, a slime mold on the Kanto plain, fireflies in the Smokies, a bell struck in Chile, the swell at Nazaré, a river on the Beni, frost on a window at Oymyakon. Touch one and fall into it. Offline; every dataset credited.

apps.name: Adrift
apps.subtitle: Glass floats on the real sea
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the open sea and it rings; rest a beat longer and a glass float is yours, lamp amber on a cool sea. The month's real currents and winds, measured by drifting buoys, carry it; nothing scripts where it goes. Written from scratch in Rust on the GPU. Offline; every dataset credited.

apps.name: Whales
apps.subtitle: Two whales, their songs and their travels
apps.localizedDescription: Pick two whales and hear them sing as they travel the real oceans. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Murmuration
apps.subtitle: A flock, and you one of them
apps.localizedDescription: Hundreds of birds on simple rules over the real sky; lean and the flock bends around you. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Mold
apps.subtitle: A slime mold finds the night's cities
apps.localizedDescription: A glowing mold on the night Earth seeks the cities' lights and finds the routes between them. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Fireflies
apps.subtitle: Every night city a firefly
apps.localizedDescription: Each city of the night Earth blinks its own rhythm; nudge one and continents fall into step. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Bell
apps.subtitle: Strike the Earth and hear it ring
apps.localizedDescription: Tap the Earth and it rings in its own measured free oscillations, the chord heard from the place facing you. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Swell
apps.subtitle: Waves on the real sea floor
apps.localizedDescription: Touch the sea and a wave crosses the ocean at the speed its real depth gives it; the coasts chime where it arrives. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Carol
apps.subtitle: Tap a piece, then where it goes
apps.localizedDescription: A wooden chess set that knows its lines: tap a piece, then where it goes. The right move slides home with a note and the other side answers; a wrong one bumps back. Twenty-four drills, openings and puzzles, the missed ones coming back first. A toy; offline.

apps.name: Shortcut
apps.subtitle: Build a road, and watch traffic get worse
apps.localizedDescription: A small town at night round a lake, its cars each taking the way that looks quickest. Draw a road from one road to another, slash one closed, and see what the drivers do: the obvious bridge can make everyone's trip slower (Braess's paradox), and nothing tells you so but the colour of the cars. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Meander
apps.subtitle: Draw a river and watch it wander
apps.localizedDescription: The Rio Beni's real floodplain in Bolivia. Draw a river with your finger: its bends grow and drift, and when a loop's neck closes the river cuts through and leaves an oxbow lake, the same shape as the real ones beneath. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Taste
apps.subtitle: A creature that becomes what you like
apps.localizedDescription: A small creature keeps changing its shape and colour. Rest a finger on it while you like what it is: it keeps trying on a slightly different self, and keeps the new one as often as you held it. It lingers where you linger, still wanders off, and every so often pulls back to show the path it took. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Frost
apps.subtitle: Your finger is warm
apps.localizedDescription: A cabin window at Oymyakon, about −50 °C, the night outside. Frost creeps in from the frame, each crystal at its own angle, meeting its neighbours along seams. Your finger is warm: what you wipe stays clear, the frost creeping back only slowly from its edges. Real snow-crystal physics (Reiter's model). A toy; offline.

apps.name: Night Walk
apps.subtitle: A walker's footprints map a land no one can see
apps.localizedDescription: A walker crosses a land in the dark. Each step it picks a spot at random within its stride: higher ground it always takes, lower only sometimes. Where its footprints pile up, a map rises; at dawn the real land comes up under it. Touch to set how far it steps. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Screw
apps.subtitle: Chop and screw a song of your own
apps.localizedDescription: A record turning on a dark page. Open a song of yours from Files; tap and it plays. Push it down and it slows, the voice dropping with it, as Houston's DJ Screw rode a turntable's pitch. Tap and it says the last beat again, in time; flick it back two bars. Your song stays on your phone. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Throats
apps.subtitle: Rock, paper, scissors on a hillside of lizards
apps.localizedDescription: A sunny California slope seen from above, every rock held by a side-blotched lizard with an orange, blue or yellow throat. Orange takes blue's rock, blue takes yellow's, yellow takes orange's, and the colours chase each other round in spirals. Draw to pour in a colour; it breaks into new arms. Pinch out for the whole hill. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Kanto
apps.subtitle: A slime mold that designs Tokyo's railways
apps.localizedDescription: The 2010 experiment where a slime mold, put down at Tokyo on a plate with oat flakes at the region's towns, grew a network of tubes much like the region's railways. Watch it spread, find the towns and thin to a network, and the real railways come up under it. Tap to lay another flake. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Nazaré
apps.subtitle: The canyon that makes the biggest waves
apps.localizedDescription: The Atlantic swell over the real sea floor off Nazaré, Portugal, where a canyon reaches almost to the beach. Watch it bend round the canyon and stack up at Praia do Norte. Drag to turn the swell or lengthen it. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Elkmont
apps.subtitle: The synchronous fireflies in a June wood
apps.localizedDescription: Night in the woods at Elkmont in the Great Smoky Mountains, where the fireflies flash together: a burst all through the trees, then dark, again and again. Hold a small light low and the females in the leaf litter answer it. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Bats
apps.subtitle: Millions of bats at dusk, and you the hawk
apps.localizedDescription: A summer dusk above Bracken Cave in the Texas Hill Country, where millions of free-tailed bats climb out of a sinkhole in a turning column and stream off over the hills to feed. You are the hawk: dive into them and watch the swerve ripple on down the stream. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Huddle
apps.subtitle: Emperor penguins keeping warm in the wind
apps.localizedDescription: Emperor penguins packed on the sea ice of Atka Bay in a winter wind, seen from above. The ones on the windward edge get cold, walk round, and press in on the lee side, so the huddle turns over and creeps downwind, and now and then a wave of tiny steps runs through it. Drag to turn the wind; touch a penguin to start a wave. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: The Wave
apps.subtitle: Start a Mexican wave in a stadium of phone lights
apps.localizedDescription: Estadio Azteca in Mexico City at night, 87,000 people, every one a phone held up as a light. Swipe along the stands and the people under your finger stand up; if enough do, a wave runs round the bowl at twenty seats a second. Too few, and it fizzles; two waves that meet wipe each other out. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Catatumbo
apps.subtitle: Lightning over Lake Maracaibo; your finger is the ground
apps.localizedDescription: Night over Lake Maracaibo, where the Catatumbo meets it and lightning flickers most nights of the year. Touch the water and a stroke forks down to your finger, grown by the rule real lightning follows; hold and it strikes again down the same channel. Every piece of the channel thunders, the near ones first. Touch the sky for a crawler under the cloud. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Moon Road
apps.subtitle: The moon paints its road down Lake Superior
apps.localizedDescription: Moonrise over Lake Superior, the water a numbered template on dark paper. Only the bits of water tilted just right send the moon's light to your eye, and each one the moon lights, it paints, so the road of light from the moon to you fills in, number by number. Tap for a gust and the road spreads; drag to walk the shore and the road follows you. Shake for a fresh page. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Bubblers
apps.subtitle: Sand-bubbler crabs drawing starbursts at low tide
apps.localizedDescription: Low tide on a Phuket beach, seen from above. Sand-bubbler crabs feed out from their burrows and leave the sifted sand behind as little balls, laid in spokes, and the beach fills with starbursts nobody drew. Tap for a footstep and they bolt, their neighbours after them; drag to draw in the sand; shake and the tide comes in. Working title; a toy in the making.

apps.name: Barchans
apps.subtitle: Crescent dunes walking the Sahara; drag to turn the wind
apps.localizedDescription: Dunes near Tarfaya in the Atlantic Sahara, from above in a low sun. One rule (the wind lifts sand, drops it downwind, and it sticks best on sand) makes crescents that walk, merge and calve. Drag to turn the wind and watch them turn; hold still to pour sand. A big dune's sliding face hums at a hundred hertz. Working title; a toy in the making.
